description: livedot for Good: rides, runs, walks and adventures that verified charities' teams are doing to raise money, live now and coming up, anywhere in the world. Use it for "charity rides this weekend", "what is Brightpath doing", "fundraising runs in Kenya". Returns each event's page (to join or follow) and its team map. Only verified charities are listed.

charity.description: The charity as the user said it: its name ("Brightpath"), its livedot address (livedot.me/brightpath) or slug.

kind.description: Only rides, runs, walks or adventures.

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: find_charity_events

outputSchema.description: Verified charities' events on livedot for Good: live now and coming up.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong.

events.description: Up to 10, live first then soonest: name, charity ({ slug, name, demo }), kind (ride, run, walk, adventure), status (live, upcoming), start (ISO), tz, place, joined, url (its livedot page), live_url (the team map), join_url (null for the demo), demo.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user.

query.description: What was searched for: charity, place, kind, live_now.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: a free account link, when the server adds one.

sponsor_line.description: The line a free answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free (never on an answer with a Donate or Support link).

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Find charity events
